latestVersion.changelog:
Phosor AI 1.0.0 – Initial Release

  - AI content generation platform, supporting Wan 2.2 14B text-to-video and image-to-video
  - Upload and use custom LoRA models for style customization
  - 16 CLI commands for job submission, uploads, status, results, and model listing
  - Supports preset resolutions (480p/720p/1080p), frame alignment rules, and usage quotas
